d:
Welcome to Kindergarten Noir, an exclusive institution attended by the offspring of prominent global figures. Within this unique setting, Teacher Rita, while actively searching for a romantic partner, has encountered difficulties in finding a suitable match. However, fate takes an unexpected turn when a remarkably attractive assassin, targeting the children, enters the scene. What follows is an exhilarating blend of action, romance, and humor, as this captivating tale unravels within the confines of the world's safest kindergarten!
=====================================================
“布莱克幼稚园”是号称“世界上最安全的幼稚园”，其下学生全是政要、名人和富商等权贵的孩子；而老师则都是为了换取减刑的前罪犯，除了教书外，他们最重要的职责是保护学生免受潜在暗杀者的侵害。某天，被称为“魔女”的前杀手丽塔开始于“布莱克幼稚园”供职，尽管以压倒性的实力击退敌人，其实莉塔却有着无法抵抗帅哥的弱点…！？全世界最安全的幼儿园，开学啦！！
n: [Non-H] Kindergarten Wars - JP Manga Volume Covers
